notes: The dock tab is one Library pill: the diagonal it shared with Albums is gone, and the library’s own Albums tab still has the albums.
The side rail is 85% see-through by default, and Tools has a slider for it - solid at one end, only the glyphs at the other.

The rail holds its place. Bringing a view in animates a transform, and a transformed ancestor is the box a fixed pill is measured from, so the rail dropped into the middle of the list on every page change.
